description: Returns the DNS records of a host or domain (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV) and its DNSSEC status.

type.description: Record types to look up. Omit for A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA and CAA.

name: lookup_dns

records.description: One list per type. A and AAAA carry `address`; MX `priority` and `exchange`; TXT `text`; CNAME, NS and PTR `target`; SOA the zone fields; CAA `flags`, `tag`, `value`; SRV `priority`, `weight`, `port`, `target`. Every record has `name` and `ttl`.

title: Look up DNS records
